page.content:
The craft role at the machine — shots, milk, and service.

How Barista connects

  • Item: Espresso machine — The barista's craft is organized around the espresso machine.
  • Item: Latte art — Latte art is the poured signature of specialty baristas.

What is Barista?

Barista, Italian for bartender, named the person who pulls espresso and texts milk. Championships and latte art made the role a profession in third-wave shops.

Key threads lead to Espresso machine and Latte art.
